clock: trusted controller wall clock around generate, validation, materialisation, all-stream synchronisation, serialization and response transfer
fresh_process: unprivileged worker process per evaluation; trusted gates in the root controller
seed_reference: unmodified seed engine measured on the same device in the same evaluation; caps derived from it (see oracle-protocol policy)
timed_scope: generation including prefill; build, warm-up, oracle and O5 work are untimed
warmup: one committed warm-up batch per cell before the first measured batch
